gate_1_copied_load_needs_no_block.claim: a saved experiment that uses a copied block loads with the block's folder deleted, its input hash reproduced exactly

prediction.why: with one provided declaration left out of the document, the load without the block either refuses the build (a law binding a missing thing) or rebuilds another experiment, whose resolved record and so input hash differ

gate_1_copied_load_needs_no_block.metric: caught/N of the planted arm, flagged/N of the clean arm

control.plant: the document's writer leaves out one declaration the block provides (a thing, a law or the declared value, drawn from the seed), as a writer that left the expansion to the load would
control.resolution: structural: one declaration of six; any one changes the input hash

gate_1_copied_load_needs_no_block.if_wrong: a miss is a document that loads the same without one of the block's declarations: the input hash does not cover it
gate_1_copied_load_needs_no_block.cannot_discriminate_if: the load is refused for another reason in both arms (the clean arm's 0/200 shows it loads)

gate_2_licence_reaches_verdict.claim: every file of the author's own in a saved folder using a copied block carries the block's conditions: the verdict is the AND of the experiment's licence and the block's
gate_2_licence_reaches_verdict.case: tests/blocks/test_block_use.py::test_a_copied_blocks_licence_reaches_the_verdict_of_every_file_of_the_authors_own (the block's licence drawn from five conditional licences, the experiment's from four open ones)

prediction.why: every drawn block licence is conditional; computed without the document's blocks the verdict is the experiment's open one

control.plant: the verdict computed without the document's blocks (copied_blocks answers none)
control.resolution: categorical: a tier and its conditions

gate_3_requires.claim: a requirement a block names that is not met here is refused as block.requires, with its pin row and one install line, and adds nothing
gate_3_requires.case: tests/blocks/test_block_use.py::test_a_requirement_not_met_here_is_refused_with_its_pin_row_and_one_install_line (the distribution, the part of its version raised and by how much drawn)

prediction.why: every drawn floor is above the installed version; with every requirement read as met the use proceeds

control.resolution: one version step above the installed one

gate_4_entry.claim: an entry of the fragment from a distribution [requires] does not name is refused as block.entry, naming the distribution

prediction.why: fixed: the lab's distribution removed from [requires]; with the check removed the use proceeds

control.plant: the entries' distributions not held to [requires]

gate_5_socket_binding.claim: a socket unbound, bound under a name the block has no socket for, bound to a thing of another kind or to one the experiment does not declare, is refused as block.socket

prediction.why: each drawn defect is the binding's own; with the binding check removed none is refused as block.socket (a wrong kind fails later as another code, or builds)

control.plant: the binding check removed (each socket bound to the name given)

gate_6_socket_definition.claim: a socket the definition cannot declare (a frame socket, a reserved name, an unknown kind) is refused as block.socket by the definition's own check, and a frame socket names the route (the apparatus lane's AP6)

prediction.why: the test asserts the definition's words; with its check removed they are never said

control.plant: the definition's socket check accepts every socket

gate_7_socket_fragment.claim: a socket the fragment writes bare, names undeclared, or never uses, is refused as block.socket by the fragment's own check

prediction.why: the test asserts the fragment check's words; with it removed they are never said

control.plant: the fragment's socket checks removed (sockets substituted with no problem recorded, no unused socket found)

gate_8_fragment_shape.claim: a fragment holding a host's key, an unknown key, a thing placed elsewhere than the world or a value of another type is refused as block.fragment

prediction.why: every shape refusal is one function's; removed, none is block.fragment

gate_9_fragment_form.claim: a fragment of another form is refused as block.format, and a later one as load.newer-form

prediction.why: removed, the form check passes every schema and the test's code list is not block.format

gate_10_name.claim: a use providing a name the experiment already declares is refused as block.name, its action naming name=, and named it is used
gate_10_name.case: tests/blocks/test_block_use.py::test_a_name_the_experiment_already_declares_is_refused_naming_name (a thing, and a declared value half the draws)

prediction.why: removed, the use proceeds and nothing is refused

gate_11_case_stale.claim: a case saved before the block's fragment changed is found by mime check as block.case-stale

prediction.why: the content hash is a sha256 of the fragment's bytes, so every edit changes it; removed, the check finds nothing

control.resolution: one byte of the fragment (a sha256 comparison)

controls.repeat: the head recorded twice: every array identical
controls.one_ulp: the toy saved with its probe's mass one ulp up: its reference outputs and its document differ (the comparison can fail)

outcomes.bits: bit_compare.py, base f7806d3a against the head, one CPU, one thread: toy and script_a every array np.array_equal (all_equal true): as predicted. The repeat control: identical, as predicted. The one-ulp control: the document's and the lock's bytes differ, and the reference outputs do NOT (the toy's mass one ulp up moved no output bit over its 10 saved steps): the prediction said both would differ, so it was wrong for the outputs. What the comparison is shown able to fail on is the document and the lock; that it would see a moved output bit rests on bit_compare.py's array_equal, not on this control.
